subject: mathematics
concept: Calculating simple probability as a fraction (favorable outcomes over total outcomes)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student counts virtual colored objects in a bag to calculate the chance of drawing a specific color
exercise.pictorial: Student writes the probability fraction from a pictured spinner or set of objects
exercise.abstract: Student calculates simple probability as a fraction for a described scenario

misconception_flags: uses the number of favorable outcomes as the denominator instead of the total

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
